edges.fact: The user is driving from San Francisco to New York City over about 10 days, planning to cycle for 3-4 of those days along low-traffic, scenic routes with a road bike.
The itinerary drives from San Francisco to Lake Tahoe, CA, approximately 200 miles taking about 3 hours, via US-50 East.
US-50 East offers stunning views of the Sierra Nevada mountains on the drive from San Francisco to Lake Tahoe.
Placerville Bike Shop, recommended for last-minute tune-ups or gear, is located in Placerville, CA, a stop on the San Francisco to Lake Tahoe route.
Lake Tahoe offers a bike ride around the lake on the Tahoe City Bike Trail, which has scenic views and relatively low traffic.
Lake Tahoe offers a bike ride around the lake on the Truckee River Bike Trail, which has scenic views and relatively low traffic.
The Village at Squaw Valley, an accommodation offering bike storage, is located in Lake Tahoe close to the bike trails.
Tahoe City Bikes, which offers bike rentals, guided tours, and shuttle services for cyclists, is located in Lake Tahoe.
Mountain Bike Tahoe, which provides guided mountain bike tours and rentals, is located in Lake Tahoe.
The itinerary drives from Lake Tahoe, CA to Jackson Hole, WY, approximately 770 miles taking about 11 hours.
Jackson Hole is near Grand Teton National Park, where the itinerary explores scenic byways and bike paths.
Grand Teton National Park contains the Teton Park Road, a 48-mile bike route with minimal traffic.
Jackson Hole has the Jackson Hole Community Path, a 20-mile paved bike trail.
The Jackson Hole Mountain Resort, which has a bike shop and offers bike storage, is located in Jackson Hole near the Teton Park Road.
Hoback Sports, which rents bikes, offers guided tours, and provides cycling gear, is located in Jackson Hole.

edges.source_entity_name: Jackson Hole Mountain Resort Bike Park
edges.fact: The Jackson Hole Mountain Resort Bike Park, which offers bike rentals, guided tours, and lift-serviced mountain biking, is located in Jackson Hole.
The itinerary drives from Jackson Hole, WY to Mount Rushmore, SD, approximately 560 miles taking about 8 hours.
Mount Rushmore is near the Black Hills region, which the itinerary explores.
The Black Hills region contains the George S. Mickelson Trail, a 109-mile converted rail-trail with minimal traffic and stunning views.
Rapid City, SD is a stop near Mount Rushmore on the itinerary.
Acme Bicycles, recommended for local knowledge and supplies, is located in Rapid City, SD.
The Rushmore Hotel & Suites, an accommodation offering bike storage, is located close to the George S. Mickelson Trail near Mount Rushmore.
Mount Rushmore Bike Rentals rents bikes and offers guided tours in the Black Hills region.
Black Hills Bicycles provides bike rentals, guided tours, and cycling accessories in the Black Hills region.
The itinerary drives from Mount Rushmore, SD to Minneapolis, MN, approximately 640 miles taking about 9 hours.
Minneapolis has the Grand Rounds Scenic Byway, a 13-mile bike route that takes riders through several parks and lakes.
Freewheel Bike, recommended for a tune-up or exploring a selection of bikes, is located in Minneapolis.

edges.source_entity_name: The Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel
edges.fact: The Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, an accommodation offering bike storage, is located in Minneapolis near the Grand Rounds Scenic Byway.
Nice Ride Minnesota offers bike-sharing services and guided tours in Minneapolis.
The Hub Bike Co-op rents bikes, offers guided tours, and provides cycling gear in Minneapolis.
The itinerary drives from Minneapolis, MN to Pittsburgh, PA, approximately 940 miles taking about 13 hours.
Pittsburgh has the Three Rivers Heritage Trail, a 24-mile bike route along the Allegheny, Monongahela, and Ohio rivers.
The 24-mile Three Rivers Heritage Trail runs along the Allegheny River.
The 24-mile Three Rivers Heritage Trail runs along the Monongahela River.
The 24-mile Three Rivers Heritage Trail runs along the Ohio River.
Pittsburgh connects to the Great Allegheny Passage, a 150-mile trail that takes riders through the Pennsylvania countryside.
Thin Man Shop, recommended for bike supplies and advice on local trails, is located in Pittsburgh.
The Omni William Penn Hotel, an accommodation offering bike storage, is located in Pittsburgh close to the Three Rivers Heritage Trail.
Golden Triangle Bike Rentals rents bikes and offers guided tours in Pittsburgh.
Venture Outdoors provides bike rentals, guided tours, and outdoor adventure programs in Pittsburgh.
The itinerary drives from Pittsburgh, PA to New York City, approximately 340 miles taking about 6 hours.
New York City has the Hudson River Greenway, an 11-mile bike route along the Hudson River with stunning city views.
The 11-mile Hudson River Greenway bike route runs along the Hudson River.
